items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: Jack and I used to play with him in his orchestra.

ctx.x: Strip shows? That kind of stuff? Whatever came along?

Hey man you know, speaking of that, we had this — there was a band. There was a man, a gentleman in L.A., his name was Meyers. And we used to call him Old Man Meyers. Jack and I used to play with him in his orchestra. He had I think three sons, one played piano, one played trumpet and one played I think bass if I remember. And he played trumpet. And Jack and I. And man, we used to play places where, roadhouses, where it was an all-colored orchestra, you know, which was a big deal, right? That type of thing.…
